description: An independent pumpkin patch in 336 Rocky Hollow Rd, GA, Rocky Hollow Pumpkin Patch grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples. The patch is busiest in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.

Contact the farm directly to confirm current hours and what is ready to pick.
